info.name: List transitions associated with a refund

params.name: account_token
params.description: Unique identifier of the credit account

params.name: count
params.description: The number of resources to retrieve.

params.name: start_index
params.description: The sort order index of the first resource in the returned array.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Field on which to sort.
Prefix the field name with a hyphen (`-`) to sort in descending order.
Omit the hyphen to sort in ascending order.

*NOTE:*
You must sort using system field names such as `createdTime`, and not by the field names appearing in response bodies such as `created_time`.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of transitions associated with the refund.
